title: Target: one machine's configuration, as observed
description: What scripts/probe-target.mjs writes for the machine it runs on, and what an entry's `target` block is a copy of. Every field carries `observable`, which says whether a product could read that field itself in a browser at runtime, or whether it took a shell on the host to see it. The catalog never matches on these fields; it only records them.

tool.description: What produced this file, e.g. "webnn-catalog scripts/probe-target.mjs".

backend.description: The browser compute backend: a WebNN implementation inferred from opSupportLimits(), or WebGPU as observed from the selected adapter.

name.description: coreml/tflite/dml/unknown identify WebNN implementations; webgpu identifies a WebGPU runtime target.

deviceType.description: The MLContextOptions.deviceType this fingerprint was taken with.

fingerprint.description: The raw fields the inference was made from. Recorded so a future consumer can re-derive `name` differently.

byDeviceType.description: The same fingerprint taken for every deviceType the browser would create a context for. Informational.

api.description: WebGPU implementation/API description, for example Dawn/Metal.

version.description: Full version from userAgentData high-entropy fullVersionList, e.g. "152.0.7977.77". The UA string alone reports 152.0.0.0.

flags.description: Command-line flags the browser was launched with for this probe. Not observable from inside the page; recorded by the harness because WebNN and the Core ML backend are flag-gated today.

profile.description: "persistent" or "off-the-record". Core ML is gated on a non-incognito profile.

build.description: Host-observed build id, e.g. macOS "25G83". Never available in the browser.

browserReported.description: What userAgentData.getHighEntropyValues() said, before the host correction. On macOS the browser reports a capped platformVersion, which is why this field and the host reading differ.

limits.description: A summary of adapter.limits, not the whole set.

host.description: Read with a shell on the machine, never from a page. An entry records these so a human can tell two configurations apart; a product cannot match on them.

loadAvg.description: 1/5/15-minute load at probe time. A busy machine is a slow machine; measurements taken next to this probe inherit it.

unavailable.description: Fields this platform's probe does not implement yet.

perfClass.description: Optional. A crude throughput class for the machine, measured rather than assumed, so two entries on nominally different hardware can be compared. It is not a ranking and the catalog does nothing with it.

method.description: How it was measured, exactly. A number without this is not a measurement.

checked.description: Whether the kernel's output was checked against the analytic value before the number was believed.
